Title: Spirit Marionette, Daring the Dawn, Freak Drive

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Can you Spirit Marionette a vampire, steal all their blood with Heidlberg Castle, hunt, play Daring the Dawn at inferior, gain a blood, Freak Drive to burn that blood, then order the Daring the Dawn damage to burn that vampire?

Heidelberg Castle, Germany
Type: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Master: unique location.
Tap to move blood, equipment cards and/or retainers between any two ready vampires you control. (You choose the amount of blood you move and which cards you transfer.) Cannot be used during an action.

Spirit Marionette
Type: Action
Requires: Obeah/Dominate
[dom]  Bleed at +1 bleed.
[obe]  Bleed at +1 bleed and tap a ready minion controlled by your prey (even if the target of the bleed is changed).
[OBE] +1 stealth action.  Take control of a ready untapped minion until the end of the next action. That minion must bleed your prey unless he or she must hunt.

Freak Drive
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Fortitude
Cost: 1 blood
[for] Only usable at the end of a successful action (after resolving the action). This vampire untaps.
[FOR] As above, but usable even if the action is blocked (play after combat, if any).

Daring the Dawn
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Fortitude
[for] Vampires cannot block this action. The acting vampire takes 2 unpreventable aggravated damage after the action resolves.
[FOR] As above, but the acting vampire takes 1 unpreventable aggravated damage.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> XZealot wrote:
> Can you Spirit Marionette a vampire, steal all their blood with Heidlberg Castle, hunt, play Daring the Dawn at inferior, gain a blood, Freak Drive to burn that blood, then order the Daring the Dawn damage to burn that vampire?
>
Yes, Freak Drive is played after resolution, and damage from Daring the Dawn is inflicted after resolution. This is the same window, you can order the effects as you wish.

PS: the quoted cardtexts are outdated (see www.vekn.net/images/stories/downloads/cardlist.txt)

Messages.Author: efialto
Messages.Body:
Notice you can steal all but one blood, and bleed instead of hunting with daring+freak.
I'd like to confirm that you can steal more blood than the amount lacking on another vampire (removing excess blood). Is that correct, right?

Messages.Author: kschaefer
Messages.Body:
Rulebook, page 7:
A vampire cannot have more blood than their capacity; if an effect puts more blood on them than their capacity allows, the excess is always moved to the blood bank immediately.
